summary: Writes a single character into a buffered output stream that may carry a codecvt encoding-conversion facet. An end-of-stream sentinel (-1) returns 0 immediately. If the internal buffer still has room the byte is stored directly at the current write position. If the output device is absent it fails with -1; if no codecvt facet exists it falls back to a plain buffered write. Otherwise the character is converted through the facet vtable conversion entry point, and the converted bytes are flushed to the output device, returning the original character on success or -1 on any error.
